rules.statement: In an action de evictione, formal notice of the suit for eviction must be served on the defendant along with a copy of the libel or plaint, and the vendor should not be made liable for more than their share of the damages.
rules.supporting_quote: "Now it- is quite clear that, to support an action de evacuation, it is necessary to allege and prove that formal notice was served on the defendant of the suit for eviction, and Voet states that the practice was in his day-and to my mind it is a reasonable practice-that a notice should be accompanied by a copy of the libel or plaint of the action in ejectment"
